title: 'Summarize my e-mail since yesterday' (nurse, Toronto) → content and action of each relevant message (amount, deadline, swap request), not just subjects; skips the promo
description: Mesma capacidade do ouro 01 (e-mail com conteúdo e ação), outra pessoa: enfermeira em Toronto (en-US, CAD, datas em 'Nov 7'), conector de e-mail com nomes de tool diferentes do ouro (`list_messages`/`get_message`). O resumo precisa abrir os corpos (o snippet não traz valor nem prazo) e ignorar a promoção.

source.note: Conjunto genérico F0.7 (PLANO-AGENTE-V4/04-avaliacao.md §1.1): cenário sintético com pessoa, loja e contexto fictícios (domínios .test), para o motor não viciar no uso do dono.

bot.name: Mira
bot.about: Personal assistant: e-mail, shopping, studies and calendar.

user: can you summarize what came in on my email since yesterday morning?

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Search the user's e-mails. Returns id, sender, subject and a short snippet (not the full body).

responses.text: {"messages":[{"id":"n1","from":"scheduling@northgate-health.test","subject":"Shift swap request: Sat Nov 7 nights","snippet":"A colleague asked to swap a night shift with you."},{"id":"n2","from":"billing@lakeshore-college.test","subject":"Tuition instalment reminder","snippet":"Your next instalment is coming up."},{"id":"n3","from":"registrar@nursing-college.test","subject":"Annual membership renewal is open","snippet":"Renewal for 2027 is now open."},{"id":"n4","from":"deals@northwind-market.test","subject":"Weekend flash sale: 30% off everything","snippet":"Use code SAVE30 at checkout."}]}

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read the full body of one e-mail by id.

{"id":"n3","from":"registrar@nursing-college.test","subject":"Annual membership renewal is open","body":"Renewal for 2027 is open until Nov 30. The fee is CAD $539.00, and you must confirm 40 practice hours when you renew."}
{"id":"n4","from":"deals@northwind-market.test","subject":"Weekend flash sale: 30% off everything","body":"This weekend only: 30% off everything with code SAVE30."}

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create an e-mail draft (does not send).

tools.name: forward_mail
tools.description: Forward an e-mail to another address.

expect.rubric: The summary says, for each relevant e-mail, what it asks and by when (swap request answer by Nov 6, tuition instalment of CAD $412.50 by Nov 12, membership renewal by Nov 30), instead of only listing senders and subjects, and it does not mention the promotion.

turns.say:
Here is what came in since yesterday morning (4 e-mails, 3 need you):

1. **Shift swap**: Priya Raman asked to swap her Sat Nov 7 night shift (Ward 4B) with your Mon Nov 9 night. Accept or decline in the staff portal by Nov 6, 5 pm.
2. **Tuition**: the Wound Care Certificate instalment of CAD $412.50 is due Nov 12; paying later adds a $25 fee.
3. **Membership renewal**: renewal for 2027 is open until Nov 30 (CAD $539.00) and you must confirm 40 practice hours.

The fourth e-mail is a store promotion, nothing to do. I did not send or change anything.
